# dsh-sidebar-balance
English | 中文
**See your balance without opening Settings → Account.**

A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that puts your signed-in
DeepSeek account balance right at the sidebar

foot, reading the same data as the Account page. It follows
the theme and the UI language, refreshe
s on click and on sign-in changes, and reports nothing anywhere.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Features

- A balance pill in the `sidebar.footer.action` slot, directly above the account/settings row.
- Rea

ds the account through the shipped `account` Remote namespace (`getBalance`, plus the `watch`
stream

for sign-in changes), i.e. the same data the Account settings page shows. No credentials are
copied

, cached, or stored.
- Refreshes on mount, when the account signs in or out (account snapshot stream

), when the pill is
clicked, and when the window becomes visible again (30 s throttle). It never pol

ls.
- Currency formatting follows the active UI language: two decimals and digit grouping, narrow cu

rrency
symbols (`¥` / `$`), amounts summed in whole cents.
- The tooltip lists every currency wallet

and any positive bonus credit, plus a refresh hint.
- Hides itself while signed out. When the sideb

ar is collapsed to the 56 px rail, the same reading
moves to the composer status row as a compact pi
ll beside the turn and token stats.
## Requirements
- DeepSeek Harness with the Web UI (Desktop app or browser). Built and verified against `0.2.1-rc.5`

.
- A signed-in DeepSeek account (Settings → Account). API-key-only setups have no Platform balance
gned-in DeepSeek account (Settings → Account). API-key-only setups have no Platform balance to show.
## Install
This repository is a Cordis bundle. The bundle patch inserts one Host row; the `dsh.client` declarat

ion in
`package.json` publishes `client.js` to the browser.
### From a local clone (recommended)
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then ask the Harness agent to install the bundle directory, absolute path:
> Install the bundle at `/absolute/path/to/sidebar-balance`
The agent runs the plugin manager's `install_bundle` with that path as the target. Installation link

s the
checkout, so later edits apply after a page reload.
### Directly from GitHub
If your Harness accepts a pnpm spec for bundles, ask the agent to install:
> `github:Qliphoth11/sidebar-balance`
Otherwise use the clone + local path route above.
## Uninstall

Ask the agent to remove the `dsh-sidebar-balance` bundle, or disable **Sidebar Balance** in
Settings

nt to remove the `dsh-sidebar-balance` bundle, or disable **Sidebar Balance** in
Settings → Plugins.
## How it works
| File | Role |

| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the `sidebar-balance` Loader row. |
| `index.js` | Host half: an empt
y `apply()`. Its only job is to give the bundle a Loader row whose `dsh.client` declaration publishe

s the browser module. |
| `client.js` | Client half: declares `inject: ['slots', 'locale', 'remote',
'remote.account']`, registers one entry in `sidebar.footer.action`, keeps the chip state in a tiny
external store exposed to React through the slot's `hooks` injection, and mirrors the account snapsh

ot stream via `ctx.remote.$stream`. |
| `locale/*.json` | Plugin-manager display metadata (title/des

cription) for `en` and `zh`. |
| `icon.svg` | Original plugin artwork. |
Styling uses only `--dsw-*` theme tokens, so the pill follows the host palette and light/dark themes

.
Visible text is routed through the Client locale service (`sidebar.balance` namespace, `en` + `zh`
Visible text is routed through the Client locale service (`sidebar.balance` namespace, `en` + `zh`).
## Compatibility and limits
- The plugin relies on the shipped slot id `sidebar.footer.action` and the `account` Remote namespac

e
(`getBalance`, `watch`). A Harness release that renames or removes them needs a plugin update.
- T

he collapsed sidebar (56 px rail) allocates a single 36 px icon cell at the foot, so the balance
mov

es to the composer status row there instead; both places share one store, so a refresh in either
upd

ates both.
- The amount is the DeepSeek Platform account wallet (recharge funds plus separate bonus

wallets). It is
not a spend counter for third-party providers or API keys.
- No telemetry, no networ

k requests of its own: every read goes through the Host account service.
- Not affiliated with or en

wn: every read goes through the Host account service.
- Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
A client plugin hot-reloads while the Web dev watcher (`pnpm run dev:web`) runs from a source checko

ut;
on an installed app, reload the page after changing `client.js`.
